in_latin.name: Andrus

in_english.name: Andrus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Andrus originates from the Greek word 'anēr', meaning man or male, and 'andros', meaning manly or virile. Andrus or Andrew is a significant name in Christian tradition, as Andrew the Apostle was one of Jesus' twelve apostles, brother of Saint Peter, and the first to recognize Jesus as the Son of God. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and leadership, embodying the virtues of a devoted Christian.

Andros was also the name of a bishop and theologian in the Orthodox Church, St. Andros of Crete, who was known for his teachings on theology and his contributions to the development of the Orthodox faith in the early Christian period.
